name: sim_cvc5_effect_system_row_typing_constraint
description: cvc5 proves effect system row typing constraints: effect membership eff∈ρ, row subset ρ₁⊆ρ₂, closure under polymorphic abstraction, preventing effect leakage via QF_LIA set membership and cardinality constraints

pytorch.reason: Effect row types are type-level constraints; no gradient descent on row membership

pyg.reason: Effect rows are algebraic row constraints; not graph structure

z3.reason: cvc5 preferred for set membership and subset constraints on effect rows

cvc5.reason: cvc5 proves row closure and polymorphic abstraction constraints via QF_LIA set membership and cardinality

sympy.reason: sympy derives effect algebra (composition, identity) for supportive cross-check

clifford.reason: Effect rows are type-level; Clifford algebra secondary to row constraints

geomstats.reason: Effect row constraints are discrete algebraic; not Riemannian geometry

e3nn.reason: Effect row typing not equivariant network problem; effects are unordered set operations

rustworkx.reason: Effect rows handled via set algebra; not graph combinatorics

xgi.reason: Effect row constraints not hypergraph structure

toponetx.reason: cvc5 set constraints drive row typing; topology secondary

gudhi.reason: Effect rows not topological; set membership is primary

test_positive_effect_membership.description: cvc5 SAT: effect read ∈ row ρ={read, write}
test_positive_effect_membership.interpretation: Effect membership is decidable via row type constraint

test_positive_row_subset.description: cvc5 SAT: row ρ₁={read, write} ⊆ ρ₂={read, write, throw}
test_positive_row_subset.interpretation: Row subtyping allows substitution of rows in polymorphic type context

test_positive_closure_polymorphic.description: cvc5 SAT: polymorphic function ∀α.(T[α]→T[α]) with α={read,write} closed under abstraction
test_positive_closure_polymorphic.interpretation: Polymorphic functions are closed under their declared row type; no effect leakage

test_negative_effect_membership_contradi.description: cvc5 UNSAT: read ∈ ρ AND read ∉ ρ is impossible (effect membership is decidable)
test_negative_effect_membership_contradi.reason: Effect membership in a row type is either true or false; contradiction is unsatisfiable

test_negative_row_subset_violated.description: cvc5 UNSAT: ρ₁⊆ρ₂ AND read∈ρ₁ AND read∉ρ₂ is impossible (subset transitivity)
test_negative_row_subset_violated.reason: Row subset constraint forbids effect membership to decrease

test_negative_effect_leakage.description: cvc5 UNSAT: throw∉α AND throw performed is impossible (effect leakage prevented)
test_negative_effect_leakage.reason: Polymorphic function cannot perform effects outside declared row type

test_boundary_single_effect_row.interpretation: Single-effect rows are valid row types (pure read-only computation)

test_boundary_multi_effect_row.description: cvc5 SAT: multi-effect row ρ={read, write, throw}
test_boundary_multi_effect_row.interpretation: Multi-effect rows constrain computation to finite declared set of operations

test_boundary_empty_row.description: cvc5 SAT: empty row ρ={} (pure computation, no effects)
test_boundary_empty_row.interpretation: Empty row represents pure computation with no observable effects
